explanation: Officers in Jabalpur are said to have added coloured balls to a game of pool in 1875. 'Snooker' was army slang for a new cadet, and the name stuck.

claims.text: Snooker was invented by British army officers in India, traditionally dated to 1875 in Jabalpur.
Around 1875 the officers added coloured balls to an existing pool game.
'Snooker' was slang for a new or inexperienced military cadet, and the game took its name from it.
